name: Shy FX
hook: A London producer whose 1994 ragga-jungle single, built on the same six-second break N.W.A had already sampled, became the first jungle record to chart in Britain.
blurb: Andre Williams, known as Shy FX, started making jungle music in London in 1992. His 1994 single 'Original Nuttah', with vocals from MC UK Apache, samples the same 'Amen, Brother' drum break the Winstons recorded in 1969 and N.W.A had already sampled in 1988, but chops, retimes and speeds it into something much more frantic: the harder, faster, broken-up rhythm that defined UK jungle. It became the first drum and bass or jungle record to enter the British singles chart. He went on to a long production career, including the 2001 crossover hit 'Shake Ur Body' with T Power and his label Digital Soundboy Recordings from 2005, but this map holds him for the one record that completes the Amen break's journey from soul through hip-hop into British dance music.

signatureTracks.title: Original Nuttah
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: With MC UK Apache; the Amen break chopped into jungle, and the first D&B/jungle record to chart in the UK.

signatureTracks.title: Shake Ur Body
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: With T Power; a UK Top 10 crossover a jungle background could still deliver.
